## helpers.ts

### `function anchorName`

The CSS anchor name for an id — `$props.id()` output is a fine id.

### `function anchor`

Pair a trigger with its floating element. Put `{@attach anchor(id)}` on the trigger (with class `anchor`) and `{@attach floating(id)}` on the floating element (with class `floating at-…`): both receive the same `--anchor` name, and CSS anchor positioning does the rest.

### `function floating`

The floating side of `anchor()`. `offset` overrides the gap (any CSS length or token).

### `function popoverSync`

Keep a boolean in step with a native popover element. Returns an attachment for the `[popover]` element: it shows/hides the popover when `isOpen()` changes and reports user dismissal through `onChange`.

### `function dialogSync`

The same for a native `<dialog>`: opens modally when `isOpen()` turns true, closes when it turns false, and reports Esc / backdrop dismissal.

### `interface RovingOptions`

- `selector` :: Which descendants are items.
- `orientation` :: Which arrow keys move. `both` accepts all four.
- `loop` :: Wrap from the last item to the first.
- `typeahead` :: Jump to the item whose text starts with what is typed.
- `tabindex` :: Manage `tabindex` so the group is one tab stop (roving tabindex).
- `onNavigate` :: Called when keyboard navigation lands on an item.

### `function roving`

Keyboard navigation for a group of items: arrow keys, Home/End, optional looping and typeahead, with a roving tabindex. Put it on the container.

### `const placementClass`

`.floating` placement modifier for a `Placement`.

### `const toneText`

Text colour class for a tone.

### `const justifyClass`

Row/container flex alignment helper.

### `const textAlignClass`

Text alignment helper.

### `function gapValue`

CSS length expression for a `Gap` rung.

### `const surfaceClass`

The registered surface class per `Surface`. `outlined` also paints the surface fill, which its edge alone does not.

### `function surfaceClasses`

A surface's class plus the decorations that belong to the same element. `tight` (the default) adds the `surface-tight` class from the data kit fragment, which zeros the 16px inset every surface class carries, so a component's own padding stays the only inset and `.stack-rule` dividers reach the border. `clip` (the default) adds `overflow-hidden` so the radius cuts the children. `vacant` has no edge, so it takes neither the clip nor the radius. Both depend on the consumer: `@fractaldesign/fractalsvelte-ui/styles` must load after `@fractaldesign/fractalstyler/styles`.

### `const alignContentClasses`

The classes an `AlignContent` needs on a `box`. `xbetween` sets `justify-content`, which a column does not use, so it takes `ta-l` as well: a disclosure's label and caret still meet at the edges, and the text never inherits its alignment from a wrapping stage. `mleft` only bites beside `ta-c` or `ta-r` (fractalstyler's typography.css), so the two mobile-first values carry the text-align class they belong with.

### `function maxHeightVar`

Max-height custom property value for a `Measure`: `measure-lg` → `var(--measure-lg)`.

### `function maxHeightClass`

Max-height utility class when `maxHeight` is a `Size` (`h-*`).

### `function defaultTextColor`

Default `TextColor` for a `Variant`: `text-inverse` on `primary`, `text-white` on `themed`/status variants, `text-primary` on light ones.

### `function maxHeightStyle`

Inline max-height custom property value when `maxHeight` is a CSS length or number.

## highlight.ts

### `type HighlightLang`

A small, dependency-free syntax highlighter for the docs: svelte, ts, css, bash, json and html. It never drops or reorders characters — the token text of every line, concatenated with newlines, is exactly the input. Token classes (`tok-kw`, `tok-str`, …) live in the display kit stylesheet, next to `.code`.

### `function closeBrace`

Index of the `}` closing the `{` at `open` (string- and template-aware); -1 if none.

### `function endOfQuote`

Index of the closing quote of the string at `i` (or the end of the line / input).

### `function lexTemplate`

A template literal from the backtick at `i`; returns the index after it.

### `function lexBrace`

A `{…}` expression (or block tag) starting at `i`; returns the index after it.

### `function lexTag`

A tag from `<` at `i` to its `>`; returns the index after it.

### `function tokenize`

Flat tokens, adjacent same-class tokens merged. Exposed for the self-test.

### `function highlight`

Lines of tokens. Joining every line's token text with `\n` reproduces `code` exactly.

## tokens.ts

### `const SPACES`

The space rungs. `Gap` and `Pad` are its class projections; this is the value.

### `const GROUPINGS`

How a group joins its members.

### `const TEXTALIGNS`

Text alignment — a different property from a container's own alignment.
